seasons.plot: A novelist in creative and marital crises finds support with her three best friends, each of whom is discovering her own path to success.

episodes.name: The Impostor
episodes.plot: In the midst of writer's block and a deadline coming up, Val leans on her friends for support and meets a charming and flirty new man.

translations.value: In the midst of writer's block and a deadline coming up, Val leans on her friends for support and meets a charming and flirty new man.

episodes.name: Signs
episodes.plot: An inspired Val works on the first draft of her erotic novel and receives feedback. Adri starts his new job. Lola gets frustrated with Sergio.

translations.value: An inspired Val works on the first draft of her erotic novel and receives feedback. Adri starts his new job. Lola gets frustrated with Sergio.

episodes.name: Alaska
episodes.plot: As tension builds between Val and Adri, she accompanies Victor to an art exhibition. Carmen checks out a new apartment with an intriguing landlord.

translations.value: As tension builds between Val and Adri, she accompanies Victor to an art exhibition. Carmen checks out a new apartment with an intriguing landlord.

episodes.name: The Pond
episodes.plot: Adri is introduced to Victor. Nerea enjoys meeting a new group of women. Conflict arises between Val and her friends at Lola's big trap party.

translations.value: Adri is introduced to Victor. Nerea enjoys meeting a new group of women. Conflict arises between Val and her friends at Lola's big trap party.

episodes.name: Mr Champi
episodes.plot: Val heads to Valencia to celebrate her mom's birthday and clear her head after the events at Lola's party, but her trip doesn't go as expected.

translations.value: Val heads to Valencia to celebrate her mom's birthday and clear her head after the events at Lola's party, but her trip doesn't go as expected.

episodes.name: My Garden Is Dry
episodes.plot: Lola's revelation results in conflict. Feeling energized about her book, Val meets with her editor again. Issues arise at Nerea's feminist collective.

translations.value: Lola's revelation results in conflict. Feeling energized about her book, Val meets with her editor again. Issues arise at Nerea's feminist collective.

episodes.name: The Package
episodes.plot: Victor and Val discuss their feelings for each other while spending the day together. Lola confronts her estranged mother.

translations.value: Victor and Val discuss their feelings for each other while spending the day together. Lola confronts her estranged mother.

episodes.name: Ellipsis
episodes.plot: Val comes to a realization about her relationship with Adri just as Victor begins to understand how important she is to him. Nerea tells her truth.

translations.value: Val comes to a realization about her relationship with Adri just as Victor begins to understand how important she is to him. Nerea tells her truth.

seasons.plot: The four friends support and lift each other up as they each make momentous decisions that will affect their respective careers and love lives.

episodes.name: Stop Running
episodes.plot: Val returns to Madrid and must make crucial decisions about her career and love life. Carmen is nervous to tell Borja they'll be competing for a job.

translations.value: Val returns to Madrid and must make crucial decisions about her career and love life. Carmen is nervous to tell Borja they'll be competing for a job.

episodes.name: If You Don't Know What to Do, Write
episodes.plot: Val has two contrasting reunions with Adri and Victor. Sparks fly when Nerea confronts a former adversary. Lola connects with an ex.

translations.value: If You Don't Know What to Do, Write
Val has two contrasting reunions with Adri and Victor. Sparks fly when Nerea confronts a former adversary. Lola connects with an ex.

episodes.name: A Book Isn't Just a Book
episodes.plot: Victor invites Val to meet his parents. Lola feels conflicted about Sergio. Carmen has a creative breakthrough. Nerea gets exasperated at an interview.

translations.value: A Book Isn't Just a Book
Victor invites Val to meet his parents. Lola feels conflicted about Sergio. Carmen has a creative breakthrough. Nerea gets exasperated at an interview.

episodes.name: Exposed
episodes.plot: The subject of Adri's latest photography exhibit takes Val by surprise. Carmen presents her campaign idea after coming to an agreement with Borja.

translations.value: The subject of Adri's latest photography exhibit takes Val by surprise. Carmen presents her campaign idea after coming to an agreement with Borja.

episodes.name: Melt Down
episodes.plot: After Adri confronts Val about her novel, it spurs the four close friends to share what they really want to pursue in their lives.

translations.value: After Adri confronts Val about her novel, it spurs the four close friends to share what they really want to pursue in their lives.

episodes.name: Omelet Challenge
episodes.plot: Val struggles with writer's block and relationship insecurities. Carmen and Borja disagree while apartment-hunting. Nerea makes a romantic decision.

translations.value: Val struggles with writer's block and relationship insecurities. Carmen and Borja disagree while apartment-hunting. Nerea makes a romantic decision.

episodes.name: Flicker
episodes.plot: The women celebrate the success of Val's book with a reading at Lola's apartment. Carmen worries Borja is lying to her. Lola reconnects with her mother.

translations.value: The women celebrate the success of Val's book with a reading at Lola's apartment. Carmen worries Borja is lying to her. Lola reconnects with her mother.

episodes.name: Reflection
episodes.plot: Val contemplates a title for her sequel. Lola gets a surprise at Victor's house. Nerea scores a new customer. Carmen has tension with Borja's mom.

translations.value: Val contemplates a title for her sequel. Lola gets a surprise at Victor's house. Nerea scores a new customer. Carmen has tension with Borja's mom.

seasons.plot: New love triangles. New life stages. Birthdays welcoming a new decade. The same four friends to navigate through it all together.

episodes.name: The Bachelorette Party
episodes.plot: Val’s new agreement with Víctor backfires. Carmen’s wedding planning doesn’t go smoothly... and neither does her bachelorette trip with the full gang.

translations.value: Val’s new agreement with Víctor backfires. Carmen’s wedding planning doesn’t go smoothly... and neither does her bachelorette trip with the full gang.

episodes.name: Balance
episodes.plot: As Val prepares to speak on a stage, Nerea jumps back into the dating scene. Lola is taken aback by a young new fling — who might not be a fling after all.

translations.value: As Val prepares to speak on a stage, Nerea jumps back into the dating scene. Lola is taken aback by a young new fling — who might not be a fling after all.

episodes.name: The End
episodes.plot: Victor finally says the words Val needed to hear. Carmen receives fantastic news, but fears she’ll be unable to find a balance.

translations.value: Victor finally says the words Val needed to hear. Carmen receives fantastic news, but fears she’ll be unable to find a balance.

episodes.name: I Was There
episodes.plot: An article prompts the girls to go down memory lane and recount stories of teenage love and heartbreaks, shedding light on their shared experiences.

translations.value: An article prompts the girls to go down memory lane and recount stories of teenage love and heartbreaks, shedding light on their shared experiences.

episodes.name: Taste You
episodes.plot: A steamy story from Bruno raises Val's temperature, and her doubts. Lola opens up to Rai about her relationship issues. Nerea finally finds a match.

translations.value: A steamy story from Bruno raises Val's temperature, and her doubts. Lola opens up to Rai about her relationship issues. Nerea finally finds a match.

episodes.name: The Word
episodes.plot: A group gyno appointment becomes a confessional — and Carmen delivers big news. Val visits Bruno in Asturias and their love takes a turn for the… stable.

translations.value: A group gyno appointment becomes a confessional — and Carmen delivers big news. Val visits Bruno in Asturias and their love takes a turn for the… stable.

episodes.name: Getting Old
episodes.plot: Val has a hard time with Bruno’s straightforwardness. Lola’s 30th birthday party brings some people together, and breaks others apart for good.

translations.value: Val has a hard time with Bruno’s straightforwardness. Lola’s 30th birthday party brings some people together, and breaks others apart for good.

episodes.name: The Decision
episodes.plot: Val finishes novel number two. Carmen’s wedding day arrives but packs chaos, making the girls scramble while also deciding who to attend with.

translations.value: Val finishes novel number two. Carmen’s wedding day arrives but packs chaos, making the girls scramble while also deciding who to attend with.

episodes.name: Personaggio non giocante
episodes.plot: Val è bloccata con il suo nuovo romanzo... e con Bruno. Carmen affronta la maternità, Nerea è alla ricerca di un appartamento e Lola organizza una rimpatriata, invitando Víctor.

episodes.plot: Bruno è fin troppo a suo agio a casa di Val, mentre Nerea vorrebbe che Georgina trascorresse più tempo da lei. Carmen si sente esclusa dai colleghi di lavoro.

episodes.name: Responsabilità affettiva
episodes.plot: Víctor supporta Val nella stesura del suo nuovo romanzo. Nerea gioca col fuoco avvicinandosi alla sua amica di pilates mentre Lola finisce nei guai per un sogno erotico.

episodes.plot: Carmen si scontra con la madre di Borja, mentre Lola cerca di ricucire il rapporto con Rai. Val festeggia il compleanno con gli amici e riceve un regalo importante.

translations.overview: Una scrittrice in crisi creativa e coniugale trova rifugio e supporto nelle sue tre migliori amiche. Tratto dai romanzi di Elisabet Benavent.
A writer in a creative and marital crisis finds refuge and support in her three best friends. Based on the novels by Elisabet Benavent.
Una escritora, sumida en un bloqueo creativo y una crisis de pareja, encuentra refugio y apoyo en sus tres mejores amigas. Basada en las novelas de Elísabet Benavent.
